summary: Frontend-only regression test of the real-geocoding pattern (OpenStreetMap) extended to all client-side create-request flows. Verified PULIZIE, BABYSITTING, ARTIGIANI configurator create flows end-to-end plus CLIENT onboarding via code review. All 3 configurator publish paths (publish-button / bs-publish / art-publish) call POST /api/geocode 200 during submit, receive real coords, then POST /api/{domain}/richieste 200 and navigate to the request detail (/pulizie/<id>?new=1, /babysitting/<id>?new=1, /artigiani/<id>?new=1). Zero JS errors, zero red screens, no crashes. Only pre-existing shadow* deprecation warnings (acceptable per main agent). CLIENT onboarding submit verified by code: onboarding-flow.tsx submit() awaits resolveCoords() -> api.geocode(address) BEFORE api.completeOnboarding(payload) with c.lat/c.lng. useMyLocation across all 5 files sets GPS coords then calls api.reverseGeocode to fill address (identical pattern to business-request).

issues: Status badge shows Italian 'In pubblicazione' while device language is English (device shows 'Craftsmen', 'Cancel', 'Waiting for...' in EN). Pre-existing i18n miss on request-detail status label, unrelated to this geocoding change but worth fixing later.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated shadow* style props usage produces console warnings ('shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'). Multiple occurrences via src/theme shadow.card. Non-blocking but should be migrated to boxShadow. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (shadow.card)

action_items: Optional: replace 'In pubblicazione' with an i18n key on babysitting/[id] and artigiani/[id] detail screens (pre-existing, not caused by this change).
Optional: migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow across theme/shadow.card usage to silence deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: resolveCoords()/useMyLocation() pattern is consistent and identical across all 5 target files (business-request, pulizie/configura, babysitting/configura, artigiani/configura, onboarding-flow, provider-onboarding).
onboarding-flow.tsx:129 submit() awaits resolveCoords() BEFORE api.completeOnboarding — payload uses c.lat/c.lng from returned real coords. Verified by code.
All submit() implementations swallow errors silently in catch (only setLoading(false)) — good UX but hides API failures from users. Not a regression here, but consider surfacing errors.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (3/3 configurator publish flows + onboarding submit code path)
